title: Sourcing Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W2 fan-out migration of the 🪵️sourcing plugin (app 🗂️curate) from its 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/📦️packages/🦀️rust (crate name semio-s-plugin-sourcing) with the full taxonomy source tree, following 📋️TEMPLATE.md exactly (the flow pilot's recipe). Scope is exclusively ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/**. Also investigating a pre-existing syntax error reported in W0-E in the old ui lib.rs before starting.
summary: Migrated the 🪵️sourcing plugin (app 🗂️curate, single artifact CurateDocument) from its 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-sourcing` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/📦️packages/🦀️rust, following 📋️TEMPLATE.md. Full taxonomy tree: 🗿️artifacts/🗂️curate (component + diff/op/dsl/pack/spr/engine), 🎛️apps/🗂️curate (component/config/terminology + 5 command groups: document/curation/filter/selection/locale + 1 mode 🗂️curate with 4 windows: pool/curated/preview/grid). All 16 SourcingCurateCommand rows decomposed via app_commands! (keyed form, no ctx needed). Verification all green: cargo check native + wasm32-wasip2, clippy -D warnings, cargo test (65/65 passing, up from a 45-test baseline + framework sanity tests + added CommandSurface wire-guard tests), wire format proven byte-identical against a captured before/after hex dump (all 19 command-variant cases). cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 + jco transpile succeeded. Old 8 crate manifests deleted (app facade, engine, dsl, op, pack, protocol, ui, manifest/artifact); 🧩️extensions (beams/windows/slabs) kept in place per template but repointed their `sourcing_curate` dependency from the deleted old engine crate onto the new plugin crate (Cargo.toml path/package + lib.rs import paths), each independently re-verified green (check/test/clippy). Found and fixed a pre-existing syntax error in the old ui lib.rs (11 arms missing a closing paren on `Ok(Emit::operations(...))`/`Ok(Emit::config(...))`, plus a missing `Fault` import) — judged mechanical/trivial (uniform pattern, unambiguous intent from correctly-formed sibling arms) rather than a genuine in-progress human edit, so fixed as part of the migration rather than carried over broken. Flagged for the registrar: root Cargo.toml member-line swap, workspace.dependencies removal, and 🎪️demonstrator's un-migrated cross-dependency on the now-deleted old sourcing app/ui crates (demonstrator's own files not touched, per instructions) plus the framework fixture-sweep crate's dependency on the deleted old app facade crate (also not touched, since repointing it now would break cargo metadata for a live shared framework crate until the registrar's atomic member-swap lands — exact fix documented in the final report instead).
